name: g88_av_sub
purpose: Step G88: Milotic's Substitute is broken on turn 2 by Raichu's Quick Attack (a damaging move without a secondary, so the absorbed hit has no secondary roll; that roll for an absorbed target comes with G74, batch 5). The hit is HIT_SUBSTITUTE, no spread damage, so no HURT_THIS_TURN (sim/battle-actions.ts:1062-1065 and data/moves.ts:18341-18370); Umbreon's Assurance on Milotic is then not doubled.
